settings.title: Shadow assumptions and tariff contract
settings.description: Local shadow preferences only; no setting enables execution. Dashboard controls use these exact same saved values. Current/recommended/original values and guidance are on the Settings dashboard. Morning is before noon; afternoon after noon; tariff peak times must increase. Aurora 93 uses fixed AEST, weekends off-peak. The stored custom weekly table is always validated and needs gap-free coverage.

error.invalid_settings: Nothing saved. Check finite planning bounds; morning before noon and afternoon after noon; increasing tariff times without overlaps; gap-free custom weekly periods (validated in every tariff mode); T-Comfort reference not above expected native target. No heater settings were changed.
